name: ponder
description: Convergent deliberation loop for coding agents - multi-pass, coverage-gated, append-only ledger review and planning.

interface.shortDescription: Coverage-gated multi-pass review and planning loop for coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Ponder runs repeated grading passes over a codebase, UI, or plan across four perspectives (Skeptic, Builder, Dreamer, Empath) with an append-only ledger and a coverage gate that refuses to stop until every unit is graded.
defaultPrompt: Ponder our codebase and grade every module for reliability and edge cases.
Ponder the UI screens and verify coverage before stopping.
